# Security Policy

## Supported Branches

Security fixes are prioritized for these long-lived branches:

- `develop`
- `staging`
- `main`

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not open public issues for suspected vulnerabilities.

Use one of the following private channels:

- GitHub Security Advisories: use the repository's private vulnerability reporting flow
- Email fallback: `admin@nelsongrey.com` (update once Sprout has its own dedicated domain/inbox)

Include:

- Affected component(s)
- Reproduction steps and impact
- Suggested mitigation, if known

## Disclosure

- Acknowledge reports within 3 business days
- Provide a follow-up status update within 7 business days
- Publish details only after a fix or mitigation is available
